pushNotifications.adminOnlyBody: The notification console is available to administrators only.
pushNotifications.broadcastSub: Goes to every seeker who accepts announcements and is outside their quiet hours: up to {0} right now.
pushNotifications.chartTitle: Notifications sent per day, last 14 days
pushNotifications.checkDeviceBody: The mobile app was built with google-services.json, and someone has signed in and allowed notifications.
pushNotifications.checkEnabledBody: PushNotifications:Enabled is true in the server's settings or environment.
pushNotifications.checkEngineBody: Background jobs are on (Hangfire:Enabled), so the engine wakes every minute.
pushNotifications.checkKeyBody: The service account key from Firebase console is given to the server as a file path or as its content.
pushNotifications.confirmBroadcastBody: "{0}" will be sent to up to {1} seeker(s). It cannot be recalled.
pushNotifications.confirmCleanupBody: Phones retired more than 30 days ago are removed from the list. A phone that is still in use registers again by itself.
pushNotifications.confirmRunBody: This sends real notifications to seekers' phones: everyone this notification's rule and their own settings allow, except anyone who already received it for this occasion.
pushNotifications.couldNotLoad: Could not load the notification console.
pushNotifications.detailDefaults: On by default for seekers: {0}. Mandatory: {1}.
pushNotifications.drawnBySystem: Android when the app is closed, the app when open
pushNotifications.imageHint: An https address of a picture, shown large when the notification is expanded.
pushNotifications.jobsHint: Run Now sends real notifications: to every seeker the notification's own rule and their settings allow, minus anyone who already had it for this occasion. Send Test reaches only your own phone and ignores your settings.
pushNotifications.messagePlaceholder: One or two sentences. The whole of it should fit on a lock screen.
pushNotifications.noDevicesBody: A phone appears here once someone signs in to the mobile app on it. A build without the Firebase file never registers.
pushNotifications.noLogsBody: Every notification the server sends is listed here, with what became of it.
pushNotifications.noRunsBody: The engine wakes every minute, and only the passes that had someone to notify are kept here.
pushNotifications.notReadyHint: The Setup tab lists what is needed.
pushNotifications.notScheduledBody: Background jobs are switched off on the server (Hangfire:Enabled), so nothing is sent on its own. Run Now and Send Test still work.
pushNotifications.pauseHint: Pause or resume this notification for everyone
pushNotifications.paused: {0} paused. Seekers' own choices are kept.
pushNotifications.previewLabel: How it looks on the phone
pushNotifications.retiredHint: A phone is retired when the push service says its token will never work again: the app was removed or its data cleared.
pushNotifications.runNowHint: Send it now to everyone who is due and has not had it
pushNotifications.sendTestHint: Send a sample to your own phone
pushNotifications.setGrace: Still Sent When Late By Up To
pushNotifications.setupHint: These come from the server's PushNotifications settings. Change them there and restart the API; the key itself is never shown.
pushNotifications.sub: Every notification as a job: what it sends, when it last ran and who it reached
pushNotifications.title: Notification Console
